paper: J. M. Dudley, G. Genty, S. Coen, Supercontinuum generation in photonic crystal fiber, Rev. Mod. Phys. 78, 1135 (2006);  see also N. Akhmediev and M. Karlsson, Cherenkov radiation emitted by solitons in optical fibers, Phys. Rev. A 51, 2602 (1995)
description: Cherenkov dispersive-wave (DW) emission from a femtosecond soliton in a PCF: the simulated blue DW peak is validated against the analytic phase-matching condition Omega_DW = -3*beta2/beta3.
